changelog: 🎙️ Voice Calls for Local Models: Extended full conversational voice call support to Local Models with on-device speech recognition, natural human cadence TTS, and pulsing visualizer orb.
⚡ Resilient Voice Mode Fallback: Automatically falls back to conversational voice mode when the Antigravity Hub lacks /voice/ws WebSocket or during network interruptions instead of failing.
✨ Clean Welcome Interface: Removed the segmented Local/Antigravity pill switcher from the home screen, keeping the welcome view focused and clutter-free.
